blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: 4D scene reconstruction requires robust handling of dynamic objects, yet existing streaming methods commonly assume static scenes, leading to pose drift and ghosting artifacts over long sequences. We introduce Stream4D, a training-free, motion-decoupled streaming reconstruction framework that can be directly integrated into causal Transformer backbones (e.g., StreamVGGT, Stream3R). Our key observation is that causal attention implicitly encodes rich temporal motion cues within the KV cache. We adaptively aggregate these cues from multiple attention layers and across temporal windows, and fuse them with depth priors to handle challenging cases such as occlusions and textureless regions, producing precise dynamic masks that decouple static and dynamic regions. We then apply a soft key masking scheme that leverages these dynamic masks to suppress interference from dynamic regions in causal attention, thereby improving camera pose estimation accuracy. Stream4D inherits the efficiency of causal attention and remains compatible with existing streaming architectures. On diverse dynamic-scene benchmarks, Stream4D significantly improves camera pose estimation and static-scene reconstruction quality, yields reliable dynamic masks, and effectively mitigates long-sequence ghosting.
blocks.zh: 4D场景重建需要强力处理动态物体,然而现有的流线方法通常假设静态场景,导致漂移和幽灵的文物在长序之上摆出. 我们引入了Stream4D(Sream4D),这是一个无训练,运动脱节的流体重建框架,可以直接融入因果变形器主干线(如SreamVGGT,Sream3R). 我们的关键观察是 因果关系隐含地编码了 KV 缓存中丰富的时间运动提示。 我们适应性地从多个关注层和跨时间窗口汇总这些提示,将它们与深度前导线连接起来,以处理诸如隔离和无纹理区域等具有挑战性的案例,产生精确的动态口罩,使静态和动态区域脱钩。 然后我们采用软密钥遮盖方案,利用这些动态遮盖来抑制动态区域在因果关注中的干扰,从而提高相机的估算准确性. Stream4D继承了因果关注的效率,仍然与现有的流体架构兼容. 在多样的动态-场景基准上,Stream4D显著改进了相机的布局估计和静态-场景重建质量,产生可靠的动态口罩,并有效缓解了长序幽灵.

blocks.en: 1. Introduction
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 导言

blocks.en: 4D scene reconstruction is a core capability for embodied intelligence systems ( Özyeşil et al., 2017 ; Oliensis, 2000 ; Su et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) , with broad applications in autonomous ( Huang et al., 2023 ; Huang et al., 2024 ; Zhong et al., 2026b ) , AR/VR ( Zheng et al., 2024 ; Zhong et al., 2025b ; Zhong et al., 2025a ) , and robotic navigation ( Wang et al., 2024b ; Wu et al., 2025d ; Wu et al., 2025a ; Wu et al., 2026a ) . Traditional SfM/MVS pipelines rely on explicit geometric constraints and iterative optimization ( Furukawa and Ponce, 2009 ; Gu et al., 2020 ) , making it difficult to balance speed and scalability ( Zhang et al., 2025d ; Zhang et al., 2025b ; Zhang et al., 2024b ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) . Recent end-to-end learning methods have advanced multi-view 3D prediction, yet pairwise approaches typically require costly global alignment and post-processing, while memory-augmented schemes are prone to error accumulation ( Zhang et al., 2025c ) . Fast3R ( Yang et al., 2025 ) and VGGT ( Wang et al., 2025a ) enable dense global interaction via Transformer feed-forward structures, but depend on global self-attention, forcing reprocessing of the entire sequence for each incoming frame. To achieve online and efficient inference, causal architectures such as StreamVGGT ( Zhuo et al., 2025 ) and Stream3R ( Lan et al., 2025 ) leverage temporally causal attention and KV-Cache historical memory, substantially reducing computation and storage on long sequences—marking a key step toward scalable 4D vision.
blocks.zh: 4D场景重建是内含智能系统的核心能力(Özyeşil等人,2017年;Oliensis等人,2000年;Su等人,2026年;Zhang等人,2026年a),在自主性中具有广泛的应用(黄等人,2023年;黄等人,2024年;钟等人,2026年b年),AR/VR(郑等人,2024年;钟等人,2025年b年;钟等人,2025年a年),机器人导航(王等人,2024年b年;吴等人,2025年d年); Wu等人,2025a; 吴等,2026a). 传统的SfM/MVS管道依赖明确的几何限制和迭代优化(Furukawa and Ponce,2009;Gu等人,2020),因此难以平衡速度和可扩展性(Zhang等人,2025d); 张等人著,2025b;张等人著,2024b;张等人著,2026b. 近期的端到端学习方法已经推进了多视图3D预测,然而对偶的方法通常需要昂贵的全球对齐和后处理,而内存增强的系统则容易发生错位积累(张等人,2025c). Fast3R(杨等人,2025年)和VGGT(王等人,2025a年)通过变形器向前结构,使得全球的密集互动得以实现,但取决于全球的自觉,迫使每个进场架构的整序进行后处理. 为了实现在线和高效率的推论,StreamVGGT(Zhuo等人,2025年)和Stream3R(Lan等人,2025年)等因果架构利用时间上的因果关注和KV-Cache历史记忆,大大减少了长序列上的计算和存储,标志着向可伸缩的4D愿景迈出的关键一步。

blocks.en: However, existing streaming reconstruction methods commonly assume static scenes and overlook interference from dynamic objects in the real world. Moving objects break photometric consistency and epipolar geometry, mislead camera pose estimation, and accumulate into ghost artifacts over long sequences. Although 3D foundation models like VGGT ( Wang et al., 2025a ; Wang et al., 2024a ) can quickly provide high-quality initial estimates, their training and inference typically default to static assumptions and lack motion-decoupling mechanisms. Prior attempts such as VGGT4D ( Hu et al., 2025 ) and Easi3R ( Chen et al., 2025 ) perform training-free dynamic segmentation via attention statistics, but respectively rely on global bidirectional or pairwise local interactions: the former is incompatible with causal streaming, and shallow-layer attention becomes ineffective under causality constraints; the latter only captures near-frame relations, yielding limited temporal consistency and boundary quality, and fails to prevent dynamic information from accumulating over time. Consequently, stabilizing dynamic-scene reconstruction under causal streaming remains a bottleneck for practical long-sequence 4D reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 然而,现有的流体重建方法通常假定是静态场景,忽略了现实世界中动态物体的干扰. 移动的物体会破坏光度一致性和地极几何学,误导相机作出估计,并在长序中积累成幽灵文物. 虽然3D基础模型如VGGT(Wang等人,2025a); Wang et al., 2024a))可以快速提供高质量的初步估计,他们的培训和推论一般默认为静态假设,缺乏运动脱钩机制. 之前的尝试如VGGT4D(Hu等人,2025年)和Easi3R(Chen等人,2025年)通过关注统计进行无培训动态分解,但分别依赖于全球双向或双向局部相互作用:前者与因果流互不兼容,浅层关注在因果关系限制下变得无效;后者只捕捉近框架关系,产生有限的时间一致性和边界质量,未能防止动态信息随时间推移积累. 因此,在因果流化下稳定动态环境重建仍然是实际长序四维重建的瓶颈。

blocks.en: We present Stream4D : a training-free, pluggable, motion decoupled streaming 4D reconstruction framework compatible with causal backbones (e.g., StreamVGGT ( Zhuo et al., 2025 ) , Stream3R ( Lan et al., 2025 ) ) for dynamic scenes. Our main contributions are as follows: • We reveal that causal attention implicitly encodes rich temporal motion cues within the KV cache, and propose an attention-based saliency aggregation method that adaptively aggregates these cues from multiple attention layers and across temporal windows. • We introduce a robust dynamic mask generation pipeline that fuses attention-derived saliency with depth priors, effectively handling challenging cases such as occlusions and textureless regions. • We design a soft key masking scheme that directly operates on the KV cache to suppress dynamic regions during historical aggregation, improving camera pose estimation accuracy without retraining or architectural modifications. • Extensive experiments on dynamic-scene benchmarks demonstrate that Stream4D , without any additional training or fine-tuning, consistently improves pose accuracy, produces reliable dynamic masks, and significantly mitigates long-term ghosting artifacts.
blocks.zh: 我们提出 Stream4D:一个与因果骨干兼容的无培训、可插塞、运动脱钩的 4D 重建框架(如SreamVGGT(Zhuo等人,2025年),Sream3R(Lan等人,2025年)),用于动态场景。 我们的主要贡献如下: 我们揭示,因果注意隐含地编码了KV缓存内丰富的时间运动提示,并提出了一个基于注意力的显著聚合方法,以适应性的方式从多个注意力层和跨时间窗口来汇总这些提示。 我们引入了强大的动态遮罩生成管道,将引人注意的突出性与深度前兆相结合,有效地处理诸如隔离和无纹理区域等具有挑战性的案件。 我们设计了一个软密钥遮盖方案,直接运行在KV缓存上,在历史聚合过程中压制动态区域,提高相机在不进行再培训和建筑改造的情况下呈现估计精度. • 对动态场景基准的广泛试验表明,Stream4D在没有任何额外培训或微调的情况下,不断提高准确性,生产可靠的动态口罩,并大大减少长期幽灵文物。

blocks.en: 2. Related Work
blocks.zh: 2. 相关工作

blocks.en: Streaming Reconstruction. Streaming approaches offer a more scalable alternative for 3D reconstruction problems, such as monocular SLAM pipelines ( Wu et al., 2025c ) . Inspired by learned online reconstruction, Spann3R ( Wang and Agapito, 2024 ) extends DUSt3R ( Wang et al., 2024a ) with memory-based updates to achieve incremental reconstruction via recursive memory writes. Fast3R ( Yang et al., 2025 ) and VGGT ( Wang et al., 2025a ) replace asymmetric decoders with Transformer-based attention stacks, enabling direct multi-view fusion and delivering strong reconstruction quality. However, these methods rely on global full attention, requiring reprocessing of the entire sequence as length grows, which limits real-time scalability. CUT3R ( Wang et al., 2025b ) adopts an RNN-style architecture to incrementally process unstructured inputs, but suffers from limited memory capacity and poor compatibility with modern hardware acceleration. Recently, StreamVGGT ( Zhuo et al., 2025 ) and Stream3R ( Lan et al., 2025 ) re-conceptualize point-graph prediction as a decoder-only Transformer ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ; Xiao et al., 2026b ) task, achieving efficient causal inference via techniques like KV-Cache and windowed attention, scaling well to long sequences while remaining compatible with modern LLM-style training infrastructure. Nonetheless, these streaming methods generally assume static scenes and lack mechanisms to handle dynamic objects, constraining applicability in real-world scenarios ( Li et al., 2026b ; Li et al., 2026a ; Xiao et al., 2025b ; Xiao et al., 2026c ; Xiao et al., 2026a ) .
blocks.zh: 流转重建. 流化方法为立体重建问题提供了更可扩展的替代方案,例如单孔SLAM管道(Wu等人,2025c)。 Spann3R(Wang and Agapito, 2024)在学习到的在线重建的启发下,将DUST3R(Wang et al., 2024a)扩展为基于内存的更新,通过递归性记忆书写来实现递增重建. Fast3R(Yang等人,2025年)和VGGT(Wang等人,2025年a)用变形器的注意力堆替换不对称的解码器,实现直接多视聚变,提供强力重建质量. 然而,这些方法依赖于全球的充分关注,需要随着长度的增加对整个序列进行后处理,这限制了实时的伸缩性. CUT3R(Wang等人,2025b)采用了RNN风格的架构,以渐进处理非结构化输入,但受到内存容量有限,与现代硬件加速兼容性差的影响. 最近,StreamVGGT(英语:StreamVGGT) (Zhuo等人,2025年)和Stream3R(Lan等人,2025年)将点图预测重新构思为一种解码器唯一的变形器(Vaswani等人,2017年;Xiao等人,2026年b)任务,通过KV-Cache等技术实现高效的因果推论和窗口关注,在保持与现代LLM式培训基础设施兼容的同时,很好地缩放到长序. 尽管如此,这些流线法一般假定是静态场景,缺乏处理动态物体的机制,限制了在现实世界情景中的适用性(Li等人,2026b;Li等人,2026a); Xiao等人,2025b;Xiao等人,2026c;Xiao等人,2026a).

blocks.en: 4D Scene Reconstruction. Early 4D reconstruction methods typically rely on RGB-D sensors ( Newcombe et al., 2011 ; Li et al., 2026c ) , limiting deployment in real-world settings ( Xu et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026b ; Wu et al., 2025b ; Zhong et al., 2026a ; Huang et al., 2026 ) . Many approaches jointly estimate depth, pose, and residual motion, often using motion masks on static regions, including self-supervised variants and test-time optimization schemes such as CasualSAM ( Zhang et al., 2022 ) and Robust-CVD. More recent pipelines, e.g., MegaSaM ( Li et al., 2025 ) , leverage strong monocular depth priors ( Yang et al., 2024 ) to achieve robust pose estimation and reconstruction on dynamic videos, while Uni4D ( Yao et al., 2025 ) combines multiple vision foundation models with multi-stage bundle adjustment for high-quality 4D results. Although effective, these pipelines depend on powerful priors and extensive test-time optimization, which hinders scalability. Recent work reduces or replaces test-time optimization using learned priors or attention mechanisms: MonST3R ( Zhang et al., 2024a ) fine-tunes on dynamic data and exploits optical flow; DAS3R ( Xu et al., 2024 ) augments the DPT head to produce feed-forward motion masks; CUT3R ( Wang et al., 2025b ) fine-tunes MASt3R ( Leroy et al., 2024 ) on mixed static/dynamic data for fast reconstruction; Easi3R ( Chen et al., 2025 ) adaptively modulates attention at inference to perform training-free 4D reconstruction on DUSt3R ( Wang et al., 2024a ) . Despite these advances, most pipelines still require fine-tuning or second-stage post-processing, and training-free variants are often tightly coupled to specific backbones. More critically, these methods are designed around global bidirectional Transformer architectures, making them incompatible with causal streaming and leaving the long-sequence accumulation of dynamic information unresolved. In contrast, our Stream4D is the first training-free 4D reconstruction framework tailored for causal streaming architectures. It achieves motion decoupling via selective KV-Cache updates, supports online reconstruction over long sequences, and avoids ghost accumulation.

Wu等人,2025b;Zhong等人,2026a;Huang等人,2026). 许多方法共同估计深度,姿势和剩余运动,常在静态区域使用运动口罩,包括自我监督的变体和CasualSAM(张等人,2022年)和Robust-CVD等测试时间优化计划. 近期的管道,如MegaSAM (Li等人,2025年),利用强单曲深度前传(杨等人,2024年),实现动态视频的强势摆姿势估计和重建,而Uni4D(姚等人,2025年)结合了多视觉基础模型和多阶段捆绑调整,以获得高质量的4D结果. 这些管道虽然有效,但依赖于强大的前兆和广泛的试验时间优化,这阻碍了伸缩性. 最近的工作减少或取代测试时间的优化,使用学到的先验或注意机制: MONST3R(Zhang等人,2024年a)对动态数据进行微调,利用光学流;DAS3R(徐等人,2024年)对DPT头进行增量,以生产向导运动口罩;CUT3R(Wang等人,2025年b)对MASt3R(Leroy等人,2024年)对混合静态/动力学数据进行微调,以快速重建;Easi3R(Chen等人,2025年)在推论上对4DUST3R(Wang等人,2024年a)进行无培训重建进行适应性调制. 尽管取得了这些进步,大多数管道仍需要微调或第二阶段的后处理,无培训的变体往往与特定的骨干紧密结合. 更为关键的是,这些方法是围绕全球双向变换器架构设计的,使其与因果流格不相容,并留下了动态信息的长序积累未解决. 相比之下,我们的Stream4D是第一个专门为因果流体结构设计的免费4D重建框架. 它通过选择性的KV-Cache更新实现运动脱钩,在长序列上支持在线重建,避免幽灵积累.

blocks.en: 3. Method
blocks.zh: 3个 方法

blocks.en: Given a casually captured video sequence { 𝐈 t ∈ ℝ H × W × 3 } t = 1 T \{\mathbf{I}_{t}\in\mathbb{R}^{H\times W\times 3}\}_{t=1}^{T} , our goal is to estimate dynamic-object masks, camera motion, and a static scene point cloud. The dynamic-object masks are represented as a segmentation sequence { 𝐌 t } t = 1 T \{\mathbf{M}_{t}\}_{t=1}^{T} . The camera motion is represented as the sequence of extrinsic and intrinsic parameters { ( 𝐏 t , 𝐊 t ) } t = 1 T \{(\mathbf{P}_{t},\mathbf{K}_{t})\}_{t=1}^{T} . The static scene point cloud is denoted by 𝒳 ∗ \mathcal{X}^{\ast} . We first introduce how a causal streaming architecture enables efficient incremental processing via KV Cache (Sec. 3.1 ). Next, we show how to aggregate motion cues from attention layers and generate dynamic masks (Sec. 3.2 ). Finally, we present motion-decoupled 4D reconstruction using the dynamic masks (Sec. 3.3 ).

blocks.en: 3.1. Streaming 4D Geometry Reconstruction
blocks.zh: 3.1. 4D几何重建

blocks.en: Given an image sequence 𝐈 t \mathbf{I}_{t} , a generic 4D reconstruction pipeline can be written as (1) 𝐅 t = Encoder ⁡ ( 𝐈 t ) , 𝐆 t = Decoder ⁡ ( 𝐅 t ) , ( 𝐏 t , 𝐂 t ) = Head ⁡ ( 𝐆 t ) , \mathbf{F}_{t}=\mathrm{Encoder}(\mathbf{I}_{t}),\quad\mathbf{G}_{t}=\mathrm{Decoder}(\mathbf{F}_{t}),\quad(\mathbf{P}_{t},\mathbf{C}_{t})=\mathrm{Head}(\mathbf{G}_{t}), where the encoder maps the input frame to image tokens 𝐅 t ∈ ℝ N × C \mathbf{F}_{t}\in\mathbb{R}^{N\times C} , the decoder fuses multi-view information to produce geometry tokens 𝐆 t ∈ ℝ N × C \mathbf{G}_{t}\in\mathbb{R}^{N\times C} , and the prediction head outputs a point map 𝐏 t ∈ ℝ 3 × H × W \mathbf{P}_{t}\in\mathbb{R}^{3\times H\times W} and a confidence map 𝐂 t ∈ ℝ H × W \mathbf{C}_{t}\in\mathbb{R}^{H\times W} . Existing methods differ in how they aggregate multi-view information in the decoder: pairwise methods (e.g., DUSt3R ( Wang et al., 2024a ) , MASt3R ( Leroy et al., 2024 ) ) process image pairs via cross-attention; memory-augmented methods (e.g., Spann3R ( Wang and Agapito, 2024 ) , CUT3R ( Wang et al., 2025b ) ) maintain an external memory for incremental updates; and global interaction methods (e.g., Fast3R ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , VGGT ( Wang et al., 2025a ) ) adopt all-to-all self-attention to achieve the highest accuracy but require reprocessing the entire sequence for each incoming frame, thus cannot support online streaming inference.

blocks.en: We propose a training-free dynamic segmentation method tailored to causal streaming architectures, which aggregates temporal motion cues directly from the KV Cache. Unlike global bidirectional methods (e.g., VGGT4D) or pairwise local methods (e.g., Easi3R) limited to adjacent frames, our approach achieves global temporal consistency via adaptive historical-frame selection and multi-modal fusion with depth priors (Fig. 4 ).

We directly modify the cached keys in the KV Cache by applying a soft suppression based on the dynamic masks: (8) 𝒞 t masked = { ( 𝐊 ~ i , 𝐕 i ) } i = 1 t − 1 , where 𝐊 ~ i = 𝐊 i ⊙ ( 𝟏 − γ ⋅ 𝐌 i ) , \mathcal{C}_{t}^{\mathrm{masked}}=\{(\tilde{\mathbf{K}}_{i},\mathbf{V}_{i})\}_{i=1}^{t-1},\quad\text{where}\quad\tilde{\mathbf{K}}_{i}=\mathbf{K}_{i}\odot(\mathbf{1}-\gamma\cdot\mathbf{M}_{i}), where 𝐌 i ∈ { 0 , 1 } N \mathbf{M}_{i}\in\{0,1\}^{N} marks dynamic tokens and γ ∈ ( 0 , 1 ) \gamma\in(0,1) controls the suppression strength. The decoder then performs temporal attention using the modified cache: (9) 𝐆 t = Decoder ⁡ ( CrossAttn ⁡ ( 𝐅 t , 𝒞 t − 1 masked ) ) . \mathbf{G}_{t}=\mathrm{Decoder}\!\left(\mathrm{CrossAttn}(\mathbf{F}_{t},\mathcal{C}_{t-1}^{\mathrm{masked}})\right). blocks.en:
Figure 6. Ghosting suppression in streaming 4D reconstruction.
Naïve causal streaming methods integrate geometry from all past frames, causing moving objects to be repeatedly fused into the scene and leaving stacked replicas along their trajectories (ghosting artifacts), which grow with sequence length and can eventually corrupt nearby static surfaces.
In contrast, Stream4D derives training-free dynamic masks from causal attention cues and applies soft key masking to suppress dynamic regions in the KV cache, so that dynamic objects appear only in the current frame while the background remains clean and sharp even in long sequences.

Naïve因果流线法将过去所有框架的几何融合在一起,导致移动的物体反复被熔化到场景中,并沿其轨迹留下堆积的复制品(鬼怪文物),这些复制品随序列长度而增长,最终会腐蚀附近的静态表面.
相比之下,Stream4D从因果注意提示中衍生出无训练的动态遮罩,并应用软密钥遮罩来压制KV缓存中的动态区域,这样,动态对象只出现在当前框架中,而背景即使在长序中也保持干净和尖锐.

blocks.en: 4. Experiments
blocks.zh: 4. 实验

blocks.en: We evaluate Stream4D across three core tasks: dynamic object segmentation (Sec. 4.1 ), 4D reconstruction (Sec. 4.2 ), and long-sequence streaming efficiency (Sec. 4.3 ), followed by ablations. Our protocol emphasizes real-time settings, causal inference, and training-free integration atop pretrained streaming backbones.
blocks.zh: 我们评价Stream4D涉及三个核心任务:动态对象分割(Sec.4.1),4D重建(Sec4.2),以及长序流效率(Sec4.3),然后是浮标。 我们的协议强调实时设置,因果推论,以及无训练的集成在op预训的流骨干上.

blocks.en: Baselines. We compare against state-of-the-art streaming reconstruction methods and training-free 4D approaches. StreamVGGT ( Zhuo et al., 2025 ) and Stream3R ( Lan et al., 2025 ) are representative causal streaming architectures but assume static scenes; VGGT4D ( Hu et al., 2025 ) and Easi3R ( Chen et al., 2025 ) perform training-free dynamic segmentation under global bidirectional designs. Stream4D applies training-free motion decoupling directly on pretrained causal streaming models, requiring no fine-tuning or additional data.
blocks.zh: 基线。 我们比较了最新技术的重建方法和免费培训的4D方法。 流线 (Zhuo等人,2025年)和Stream3R(Lan等人,2025年)是代表性的因果流体建筑,但承担静态场景;VGGT4D(Hu等人,2025年)和Easi3R(Chen等人,2025年)在全球双向设计下进行无培训动态分割. Stream4D在预先训练的因果流模型上直接应用训练自由运动脱钩,不需要微调或额外数据.

blocks.en: Datasets. We assess dynamic object segmentation on the DAVIS-2016 ( Perazzi et al., 2016 ) , DAVIS-2017 ( Pont-Tuset et al., 2017 ) , and DAVIS-all benchmarks, following the official protocols. For 4D reconstruction and camera pose estimation, we evaluate on the DyCheck dataset ( Gao et al., 2022 ) , reporting the pose error metrics (ATE, RTE, RRE). Additionally, to validate scalability and efficiency, we conduct performance benchmarks on sequences with varying lengths ranging from 10 to 200 frames.
blocks.zh: 数据集. 我们评估DAVIS-2016(Perazzi等人,2016年),DAVIS-2017(Pont-Tuset等人,2017年)和DAVIS-所有基准的动态天体分解,遵循官方协议. 对于4D重建和相机进行估计,我们对DyCheck数据集(Gao等人,2022年)进行评估,报告姿势误差(ATE、RTE、RRE)。 此外,为了验证可伸缩性和效率,我们对长度从10至200帧不等的序列进行业绩基准。

We plot the predicted trajectory (solid blue) against the ground truth (dashed gray) in the x x - z z plane. Left: Stream3R exhibits noticeable drift and erratic deviations, particularly in sequences with large dynamic motion ( handwavy , mochi-high-five ), where moving objects corrupt the pose estimation. Right: our Stream4D produces trajectories that more closely follow the ground truth, demonstrating that motion-decoupled masking effectively mitigates the interference of dynamic regions on camera pose estimation.

blocks.en: 4.1. Dynamic Object Segmentation
blocks.zh: 4.1. 动态对象分割

blocks.en: We evaluate dynamic object segmentation on DAVIS-2016 ( Perazzi et al., 2016 ) , DAVIS-2017 ( Pont-Tuset et al., 2017 ) , and DAVIS-all following the official DAVIS protocol and splits. Metrics are the mean IoU 𝒥 M \mathcal{J}_{M} and the IoU recall 𝒥 R \mathcal{J}_{R} , which jointly measure segmentation accuracy and robustness. All online methods are strictly single-pass and forbid future-frame access to comply with causal streaming constraints. Our method and the causal baselines use identical resolution and preprocessing to ensure a controlled comparison. Since the original StreamVGGT ( Zhuo et al., 2025 ) lacks a segmentation head, we integrate the temporal attention aggregation to produce saliency maps, then apply temporal consistency filtering and thresholding to generate binary masks. Easi3R_online keeps the original implementation and parameters, with the only change of disabling historical-frame access to match causal streaming. Offline methods (DUSt3R ( Wang et al., 2024a ) , MonST3R ( Zhang et al., 2024a ) , DAS3R ( Xu et al., 2024 ) , VGGT4D ( Hu et al., 2025 ) , and Easi3R ( Chen et al., 2025 ) variants) use author-recommended configurations and serve as performance upper bounds.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了DAVIS-2016(Perazzi等人,2016年),DAVIS-2017(Pont-Tuset等人,2017年)和DAVIS-all遵循DAVIS官方协议和拆分. 量子(Metrics)是IoU J M\mathcal{J}_{M}和IoU召回J R\mathcal{J}_{R}的平均值,它们共同测量分解的准确性和强性. 所有在线方法都严格采用单一通道,并禁止未来进入框架以遵守因果源流限制。 我们的方法和因果基线使用相同的分辨率和预处理,以确保对照比较。 由于最初的StreamVGGT(Zhuo等人,2025年)缺少分块头,我们整合了时间注意力集合来制作显著的地图,然后应用时间一致性过滤和阈值来生成二进制面具. Eeasi3R_在线保留了原来的执行和参数,唯一的改变是使历史帧访问功能无法匹配因果流. 离线方法(DUST3R(王等人,2024a),MONST3R(张等人,2024a),DAS3R(徐等人,2024),VGGT4D(胡等人,2025),Easi3R(陈等人,2025)变种)使用作者推荐配置,并作为性能上限.

blocks.en: Quantitative results. Table 1 presents the results on three DAVIS benchmarks. In the offline setting, methods like VGGT4D and Easi3R_monst3r establish strong upper bounds by leveraging bidirectional global attention over the entire video sequence. However, performance typically degrades significantly in the streaming setting due to the absence of future context and the inherent difficulty of incremental temporal reasoning. Existing streaming methods (CUT3R, Stream3R, StreamVGGT), originally designed for geometry estimation without native segmentation support, struggle to produce accurate dynamic object masks even with our carefully adapted implementation, highlighting a fundamental limitation of purely geometric streaming architectures.
blocks.zh: 量化结果。 表1列出了三个DAVIS基准的结果。 在离线设定中,VGGT4D和Easi3R_monst3r等方法通过利用双向全球关注在整个视频序列上建立强大的上限. 然而,由于缺乏未来背景和递增时间推理的固有困难,在流派环境中,性能通常会显著下降。 现有的流体学方法(CUT3R,Stream3R,SreamVGGT),最初是为了进行几何估计而设计的,没有本土的分化支持,即使在我们经过精心调整的实施下,努力生产准确的动态物体面具,突出了纯几何流体结构的根本局限性.

blocks.en: Our Stream4D substantially outperforms all streaming baselines across all three benchmarks, narrowing the gap with offline methods. Compared to the strongest streaming competitor StreamVGGT, Stream4D achieves absolute gains of + 8.48 +8.48 ( 43.39 43.39 vs. 34.91 34.91 ) on DAVIS-2016, + 9.12 +9.12 ( 46.45 46.45 vs. 37.33 37.33 ) on DAVIS-2017, and + 9.86 +9.86 ( 43.06 43.06 vs. 33.20 33.20 ) on DAVIS-all in terms of mean IoU ( 𝒥 M \mathcal{J}_{M} ). Similar improvements are consistently observed in recall ( 𝒥 R \mathcal{J}_{R} ), demonstrating the effectiveness of our unified architecture for joint geometry and segmentation under strict streaming constraints.
blocks.zh: 我们的Stream4D大大超过了所有三个基准的所有流线基线,用离线方法缩小了差距。 与最强流体竞争者StreamVGGT相比,Stream4D在DAVIS-2016(43.39 43.39 vs 34.91 34.91)上实现了绝对增益,在DAVIS-2017(46.45 46.45 vs 37.33 37.33)上实现了绝对增益,在DAVIS-all上实现了绝对增益,以平均值IoU(J M\mathcal{J}_{M}). 类似的改进在召回(J R \ mathcal{J}_{R})中不断出现,表明我们在严格的流线限制下进行联合几何和分化的统一架构的有效性.

blocks.en: Qualitative results. Fig. 5 presents representative sequences comparing the input frame, Easi3R masks, and our masks. Due to pairwise adjacent statistics only, Easi3R is prone to temporal jitter and boundary breaks under short-term occlusions and non-rigid deformations. In contrast, our streaming multi-level temporal aggregation with consistency constraints maintains stable segmentation and complete boundaries across both slow motions (e.g., camel, goat, pig, dog) and fast motions (e.g., skateboarder, motorcyclist); masks evolve smoothly over time and align with true motion patterns, demonstrating the robustness and adaptability of our causal attention-based approach in online settings. More visualized results can be found in the appendix.
blocks.zh: 定性结果. 图5介绍了比较输入框、Eeasi3R口罩和我们的口罩的代表性序列。 仅由于相邻的对称统计,Easi3R在短期闭塞和非硬化变形下容易发生时间紧张和边界断裂. 与此相对照的是,我们在一致性制约下流转的多层次时间聚集保持了稳定的分化,并跨越了缓慢运动(如骆驼,山羊,猪,狗)和快速运动(如滑板手,摩托车手)的完整界限;口罩随时间而平稳地演化,与真实的运动模式保持一致,显示了我们基于因果关注的方法在在线环境下的强健性和适应性. 更多可视化的结果可见于附录.

blocks.en: Figure 8. Inference time comparison across different sequence lengths. While Easi3R exhibits exponential time growth and suffers from Out-of-Memory (OOM) errors between 100 and 200 frames, Stream4D maintains linear scalability, performing comparably to the efficient StreamVGGT baseline.

blocks.en: 4.2. 4D Reconstruction

We evaluate 4D reconstruction performance on the DyCheck dataset, a challenging benchmark comprising real-world monocular videos with complex object motion, primarily focusing on camera pose estimation accuracy. Following prior work, we report standard pose metrics including Absolute Trajectory Error (ATE), Relative Translation Error (RTE), and Relative Rotation Error (RRE). All streaming methods operate in single-pass causal mode, strictly forbidding access to future frames to ensure a fair and realistic evaluation protocol.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了DyCheck数据集上的4D重建性能,这是一个挑战性的基准,由具有复杂物体运动的由现实世界的单视视频组成,主要侧重于相机呈现出估计准确性. 继先前的工作之后,我们报告标准设置了包括绝对轨迹错误(ATE),相对翻译错误(RTE)和相对旋转错误(RRE)在内的计量标准. 所有流线方法都以单通道因果模式运行,严格禁止访问未来帧,以确保公平和现实的评价协议.

blocks.en: Quantitative results. Table 2 summarizes results on DyCheck. Offline methods such as VGGT4D achieve strong performance by leveraging full-sequence optimization, improving over their respective bases (VGGT, MonST3R, DUSt3R). Among streaming methods, CUT3R—despite being extensively trained across diverse datasets—serves as a competitive concurrent baseline. Our method (Stream4D), operating training-free and within causal streaming constraints, delivers accurate and complete reconstructions comparable to or better than most baselines, and on pose metrics achieves consistent improvements over Stream3R (ATE 0.014 0.014 , ↓ \downarrow 6.7%; RTE 0.017 0.017 , ↓ \downarrow 5.6%; RRE 0.539 0.539 , ↓ \downarrow 1.1%), while maintaining identical reconstruction metrics to isolate the effect of motion decoupling.
blocks.zh: 量化结果。 表2汇总了DyCheck的结果。 VGGT4D等离线方法通过利用全序优化,改善各自基础(VGGT,MONST3R,DUST3R),实现强性能. 在流式方法中,CUT3R——尽管在各种数据集中受到广泛培训——服务作为竞争性的并行基准。 我们的方法(Stream4D),在无培训的情况下,在因果源源流的限制下,提供与大多数基线相当或更好的准确和完整的重建,在布局指标上,比Stream3R(ATE 0.014 0.014, == 下行6.7%;RTE 0.017 0.017, === 下行)取得了一致的改进。 5.6%; RRE 0.539 0.539, \\ downarrow 1.1%),同时保持相同的重建度量,以隔离运动脱钩的效果.

blocks.en: Qualitative results. Fig. 7 compares the reconstruction quality of Stream3R ( Lan et al., 2025 ) and Stream4D on representative dynamic sequences. As shown, the baseline Stream3R exhibits severe entanglement between dynamic and static elements, leading to geometric corruption, appearance distortion, and ghosting artifacts in regions of significant motion. In contrast, our Stream4D significantly improves reconstruction fidelity in this challenging streaming setting. The improvement stems from two key designs: (1) attention-based dynamic segmentation that robustly separates motion from the static background without requiring external supervision, and (2) soft key masking that suppresses dynamic interference during historical aggregation. More visualized results are provided in the appendix.
blocks.zh: 定性结果. 图7比较了Stream3R(Lan等人,2025年)和Sream4D在代表性动态序列上的重建质量. 如所示,基线Stream3R显示出动态元素和静态元素之间的严重缠绕,导致几何腐败,外观扭曲,以及重大运动区域中的幽灵文物. 与此相对照,我们的Stream4D在这种充满挑战的流派环境中大大提高了重建忠心。 改进来源于两个关键设计:(1)基于注意力的动态分割,将运动与静态背景强力分离而不需要外部监督;(2)软密钥掩蔽,抑制历史聚合过程中的动态干扰. 附录中提供了更多的可视化结果。

blocks.en:
Ghosting suppression. A core failure mode of causal streaming reconstruction in dynamic scenes is temporal over-integration: as each new frame attends to and fuses information from the past, moving objects are repeatedly written into the scene, creating stacked geometric replicas along their motion paths (ghosting artifacts).
This artifact intensifies with longer sequences and may eventually bleed into nearby static surfaces, degrading ground, building facades, and road textures.
As illustrated in Fig. 6 , baseline streaming methods exhibit clear motion trails—pedestrians and vehicles appear multiple times at different locations, forming overlapping silhouettes and blurred structures.
blocks.zh:
幽灵压制. 动态场景中因果流重建的一种核心故障模式是时空过度整合:由于每个新框架都关注并熔化过去的信息,移动的物体会反复被写入场景中,沿其运动路径产生堆叠的几何复制品(暗藏文物).
这种文物以更长的序列强化,最终可能流血成附近的静态表面,降解地面,建筑外观,以及道路纹理.
如图6所示,基线流线方法显示有明显的运动痕迹——行车和车辆在不同地点多次出现,形成重叠的斜线和模糊的结构。

blocks.en:
Stream4D suppresses this accumulation by decoupling motion from the causal fusion process.
Specifically, we aggregate temporal saliency from causal attention to derive dynamic masks on-the-fly, and apply soft key masking to suppress dynamic regions in the cached keys. This prevents dynamic features from dominating historical aggregation, so that the static background remains stable and sharp, and dynamic objects are retained only in the current frame without overlapping replicas, even over long streaming sequences.
blocks.zh:
Stream4D通过将运动与因果核聚变过程脱钩来抑制这种积累.
具体地说,我们从因果关注中总结出时间优势,在飞行时产生动态罩,并应用软密钥遮盖来压制缓存密钥中的动态区域. 这使得动态特征无法主导历史聚合,从而使静态背景保持稳定和尖锐,动态对象只保留在当前框架里,没有重叠的复制品,甚至超过长流序列.

blocks.en: 4.3. Efficiency and Scalability
blocks.zh: 4.3. 效率和可扩展性

blocks.en: We evaluate the inference time and scalability of our proposed method across varying image sequence lengths ( N ∈ { 10 , 20 , 50 , N\in\{10,20,50, 100,200 } 100,200\} ) with an input resolution of 512 × 384 512\times 384 on a single NVIDIA A100 GPU. Figure 8 illustrates the comparison between Easi3R ( Chen et al., 2025 ) , StreamVGGT ( Zhuo et al., 2025 ) , and our Stream4D. As shown, Easi3R ( Chen et al., 2025 ) suffers from severe computational bottlenecks due to its reliance on global pairwise attention. Its inference time grows quadratically, reaching 260.0s at N = 100 N=100 . Crucially, due to its heavy memory footprint, Easi3R ( Chen et al., 2025 ) fails to process longer sequences entirely, triggering an Out-of-Memory (OOM) error before reaching N = 200 N=200 .

blocks.en: In contrast, Stream4D demonstrates robust scalability with near-linear growth in computation. By leveraging a causal architecture similar to StreamVGGT, Stream4D maintains efficient inference even for long sequences. At N = 200 N=200 , Stream4D achieves an inference time of 93.1s, which is comparable to the highly efficient StreamVGGT baseline (84.1s). The marginal increase in latency ( ≈ \approx 10%) is attributed to the lightweight overhead introduced by our dynamic segmentation and soft key masking mechanisms. This result confirms that Stream4D successfully avoids the OOM issues of Easi3R while maintaining high computational efficiency for long-term 4D reconstruction, making it highly practical for continuous real-world video applications.
blocks.zh: 与此相反,Stream4D在计算中表现出了强大的可伸缩性,近线性增长. 通过利用类似于StreamVGGT的因果架构,Stream4D即使在长序列中也保持高效的推论. 在N = 200 N = 200时,Stream4D的推导时间为93.1s,与高效的SreamVGGT基线(84.1s)相当. 耐久性略有增加(\\\\ 10%), 是因为我们动态的分解和软密钥遮盖机制引入了轻量级高空。 这一结果证实Stream4D成功避免了Eeasi3R的OOM问题,同时维持了长期4D重建的高计算效率,使得连续的实时视频应用非常实用.

blocks.en: 5. Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5.五. 结论

blocks.en: We present the Stream4D, a training-free framework for motion-decoupled 4D scene reconstruction tailored to causal streaming architectures. Our key insight is that causal attention implicitly encodes rich temporal motion cues within the KV cache. Leveraging multi-level attention aggregation with depth priors, we derive reliable dynamic masks that decouple static and dynamic regions. We then apply soft key masking to directly suppress dynamic regions in the cached keys, preventing dynamic features from interfering with historical aggregation. This design improves camera pose estimation accuracy and helps mitigate ghosting artifacts over long sequences, all under strict single-pass, causal inference constraints. Experiments on DAVIS and DyCheck demonstrate that Stream4D achieves competitive or superior performance compared to existing streaming baselines in both dynamic segmentation and pose estimation, while maintaining efficient inference for long-sequence 4D reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍Stream4D,一个适合因果流体结构的无培训框架。 我们的关键洞察力是 因果关系隐含在 KV 缓存中 编码了丰富的时间运动提示 利用多层次的注意力和深度前期的聚合,我们获得可靠的动态面具,使静态和动态区域脱钩。 然后我们应用软密钥遮盖来直接压制缓存密钥中的动态区域,防止动态特性干扰历史聚合. 这种设计改进了相机的预测准确性,并有助于减轻长时间序列上的幽灵文物,所有这些都受到严格的单传,因果推论的限制. 对DAVIS和DyCheck的实验表明,与现有的流线基线相比,流线4D在动态分解和形成估计方面都实现了竞争性或优越性能,同时对长序4D重建保持高效的推论.

blocks.en: Limitations and future work. While Stream4D demonstrates the potential of mining motion cues from causal attention, current aggregation relies primarily on attention statistics and depth priors. Future work will explore richer cue extraction from the KV cache, such as incorporating cross-scale temporal patterns and semantic-aware saliency. Beyond static-scene reconstruction, we aim to extend the framework toward dynamic object reconstruction by leveraging the decoupled motion representations.
blocks.zh: 限制和今后的工作。 虽然Stream4D显示采矿运动提示从因果注意中产生的潜力,但目前的汇总主要依靠注意统计和深度前科。 今后的工作将探索从KV缓存中提取更丰富的线索,例如纳入跨尺度的时间规律和语义意识的显著性。 除了静态场景的重建外,我们的目标是通过利用脱节的运动表述,将框架扩大到动态物体的重建。
